_comment: Free open-weight model self-hosted on the Colab GPU with Ollama (no API key, no rate limit). Start it with: bash MP4/scripts/setup_ollama.sh qwen3:8b . Fits a free T4 (16 GB) with a 32k context. On an L4/A100 runtime use qwen3:14b (pass --model qwen3:14b). Context limits are smaller than for hosted models, so files are read in smaller chunks and old tool output is compacted earlier.
